messages.content: "Can you help me with the following tasks? I specifically want to know about its 'material'. Lastly, I drove my car, which uses 'diesel' as fuel and has a fuel efficiency of 25 miles per gallon, for a total distance of 12000 miles last year. Can you calculate the annual carbon dioxide emissions produced by my vehicle? Also, consider a 2% decrease in fuel efficiency per year."

function.name: calculate_emissions

efficiency_reduction.description: The percentage decrease in fuel efficiency per year (optional). Default is 0
